evals.name: audit-five-entities
evals.prompt: Check my dbt models against the business knowledge bundle. I've built staging models for FinancialTransaction, Customer, Product, ProfitCenter, and GLAccount.
evals.expected_output: A structured audit report with Summary, Missing Entities, Business Rules, Pre-Flight, Numerical Validation, Business Questions, and Risks sections

assertions.text: Discovers the bundle and reads index.md
Flags FiscalCalendar as a missing entity referenced by FinancialTransaction's fiscal_calendar_id FK
Identifies all 7+ distinct business rules across the 5 implemented entities
Deduplicates cross-entity rules (e.g., Hash # sentinel reported once with all affected entities, not repeated per entity)
Reads specialized-instructions.md pre-flight checklists for all 5 entities
References numerical-examples.md for count validation baselines (53 customers, 35 products, 37 profit centers, 21 GL accounts, 167,136 transactions)
Identifies Q018, Q019, Q020 as partially covered due to missing FiscalCalendar
Surfaces relevant known gaps (Gap 1: 37th profit center, Gap 9: P&L hierarchy completeness)
Report leads with Summary section, not details
Ranks blockers by impact — data-corrupting issues above cosmetic ones

evals.name: audit-single-entity
evals.prompt: I just built a staging model for FinancialTransaction. Check it against the bundle — did I handle everything?
evals.expected_output: A focused audit on FinancialTransaction covering its 7 business rules, 9 pre-flight items, and relevant numerical examples

assertions.text: Checks all 7 business rules affecting FinancialTransaction
Runs all 9 pre-flight checklist items from specialized-instructions.md for FinancialTransaction
Flags the European comma decimal conversion as a high-impact data-corrupting risk
Flags missing FiscalCalendar as a structural gap (FK reference from FinancialTransaction)
